Name: Havilah, Son of Joktan
Summary: Havilah was a son of Joktan and a descendant of Eber, in the line of Shem.
KeyStory: Havilah is named among Joktan's sons, whose dwelling stretched from Mesha toward Sephar.
RelatedPeople: Joktan; Sheba, Son of Joktan; Ophir
LifeLesson: God's promise to fill the earth moved forward through families like this one.
